risks.risk: The console may not actually be working (no boot/test shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the PS4 powering on, reaching the home screen, and playing a game (or showing system settings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until proven.

risks.risk: Game bundle mismatch: seller mentions FIFA 24/FIFA 26 and other titles, but photo shows only one FIFA case that appears to be FIFA 21; other games may be missing or different.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all included game discs/cases (front and back) or a video showing the installed games list on the PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Price as only the single visible FIFA case being included; other claimed games treated as not included.

risks.risk: Controllers may be wired only, may have drift/defects, or may not be the exact quantity/condition claimed.
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connected and working (button test / moving in a game menu).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers untested (assume possible faults) until proven.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (e.g., HDMI cable, power cable, charging dock) not shown clearly.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller cables, any manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories until confirmed.

risks.risk: Model/condition uncertainty (PS4 Slim appearance but no readable label; could be different revision or heavily worn).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console label/serial/model number sticker and a photo of ports/vent area.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case condition for a used PS4 Slim with unknown wear.

proof_requests: Send a short video: PS4 boots to home screen (no error), then opens a game and shows it running.
Send clear photos of all included games (front/back of each case or discs). If installed, show the installed games list on the PS4.
Send a video/button test showing both controllers working (no drift, all buttons respond).
Send a photo of all accessories included (power cable, HDMI, controller cables).
Send a close-up of the console model/serial label sticker.
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 console and two controllers, but there is no working/boot proof and the game list in the seller’s words doesn’t match what’s visibly shown (the FIFA case appears different). To price safely, we need proof the console works and confirmation of the exact games included.
